In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Cayleyan''' is a [[algebraic variety|variety]] associated to a [[hypersurface]] by {{harvs|txt|first=Arthur|last=Cayley|authorlink=Arthur Cayley|year=1844}}, who named it the '''pippian''' in {{harv|Cayley|1857}} and also called it the '''Steiner–Hessian'''.

*[[Quippian]]
